native_review.summary: The user successfully completed both tasks: returning the non-water-resistant, more expensive speaker and modifying the 17-inch laptop to the 13-inch i5/1TB SSD/silver variant. The user followed instructions (including the rude persona) and provided only grounded information; no user errors were found. The agent correctly authenticated the user, retrieved order and product details, presented accurate available options, listed action details, and obtained explicit confirmation before executing both actions. However, the agent repeatedly violated the interaction policy by sending user-facing messages while making tool calls (turns 10, 15, 12, 21) and by making multiple tool calls simultaneously (turns 12 and 21). These violations did not affect the final outcome, so they are classified as minor.

errors.reasoning: The assistant sent a user-facing message ('I found your account...') and made a tool call (get_user_details) in the same turn, violating the policy that the agent must not respond to the user and make a tool call at the same time.
errors.correct_behavior: The agent should have made the tool call without a simultaneous user message, or waited to send the message until after receiving the tool result.

errors.reasoning: The assistant sent a user-facing message and made two tool calls (get_order_details for two orders) in the same turn, violating the policy of at most one tool call at a time and the policy against responding to the user while making tool calls.
errors.correct_behavior: The agent should have made one tool call at a time without a user message, then continued after receiving the results.

errors.reasoning: The assistant sent a user-facing message ('Let me look at the product details...') and made a tool call (get_product_details) in the same turn, violating the policy that the agent must not respond to the user and make a tool call at the same time.
errors.correct_behavior: The agent should have made the tool call alone, then responded to the user after receiving the product details.

errors.reasoning: The assistant sent a user-facing message and made two tool calls (return_delivered_order_items and modify_pending_order_items) simultaneously in the same turn, violating the policy of at most one tool call at a time and the policy against responding to the user while making tool calls.
errors.correct_behavior: The agent should have executed the return and modification tool calls one at a time, without sending a user message in the same turn.
